author: caajitrai
quote: 13 Years of Waiting for This?After waiting 13 years for GTA VI, I honestly expected something unforgettable. Instead, I got a game that looks incredible but feels disappointingly hollow where it matters most: the story, the characters, and the actual fun of **** graphics and open world are undeniably impressive, but beautiful visuals cannot compensate for a weak narrative. Jason feels like a bland, passive character, while the relationship between him and Lucia often feels forced rather than genuinely compelling. I wanted to play a crime story about two dangerous, unpredictable characters — not watch Jason being reduced to a glorified sidekick in his own **** missions feel frustratingly restrictive, the police are ridiculously aggressive, and the overall experience often feels more like completing tedious chores than enjoying a GTA sandbox. Rockstar seems obsessed with realism and simulation while forgetting what made GTA V and its predecessors so entertaining: freedom, chaos, memorable characters, and genuinely exciting storytelling.A game that took 13 years to make should have delivered something revolutionary in every meaningful sense. Instead, GTA VI feels like an overhyped, over-polished disappointment.A stunning technical achievement, but a disappointing Grand Theft Auto. The world is impressive. The experience simply isn’t.
